description: Rung 6 of DETERMINEX_LIVE_REACT_UNIFIED_PRODUCT_SHELL_SERIES. Live React LearningStudioPanel at frontend/src/components/ide-product-shell/LearningStudioPanel.tsx. Renders 9 required learning modes (explain_this_repo, explain_this_file, explain_this_error, explain_this_test_failure, teach_me_the_concept, compare_possible_fixes, walk_me_through_the_patch, show_beginner_vs_professional_version, generate_learning_checklist). Captions enforced: 'Learning explains. Learning does NOT approve, apply, or authorize source mutation', 'Learning cannot approve a patch', 'Learning cannot mark repair success', 'Learning cannot mutate source'. Route links: 'Open in Repo Clinic' (data-routes-to=repo_clinic) for fix suggestions; 'Open in Idea Lab' (data-routes-to=idea_lab) for new-project suggestions. Teaching-window explains blocked reasons by naming the gate. Tests forbid mutating Tauri verbs and forbidden phrases ('patch applied', 'now fixed', 'source mutation authorized', 'training row written').
